notes: acceptable_verdicts is a list, not a single value: any verdict in it counts as correct for this topic_id.

This is a THIRD, independent synthetic application (Apex Grid Testing Services, LLC) against the same true_requirements.json as data/36C25526Q0501 -- built specifically to add another contradictory example of a fresh shape (a standard-edition conflict: NFPA 70E 2021 edition claimed in Technical Capabilities versus 2018 edition claimed in a later Personnel Note for the same technicians' certifications), distinct from application.txt's include-then-defer-to-request contradiction and application_b.txt's amendment-existence contradiction on this tender.

Most other topics are given straightforward compliant treatment in this variant since the goal of this pass is specifically to add contradictory-class density and format diversity, not to re-exercise every failure shape again.
description is copied verbatim from the matching topic_id in true_requirements.json so this file can be read alone.

primary_verdict / primary_verdict_source (added by SFT data-prep pass): a single training-target label per topic, additive -- acceptable_verdicts is unchanged and remains the source of truth for verdict-accuracy scoring. primary_verdict is the pipeline's own correct prediction where one exists (source: pipeline_prediction), else acceptable_verdicts[0] (source: acceptable_verdicts_first). null for topics with acceptable_verdicts: null (excluded from SFT training, same as they're excluded from verdict scoring).

verdicts.description: Offer must include a technical capabilities letter, not exceeding five pages, describing the offeror's technical approach, methodology, and technique for carrying out the Performance Work Statement.
verdicts.rationale: Application only states that the offeror has experience performing NETA-standard electrical testing, without describing any actual technical approach, methodology, or technique for carrying out the Performance Work Statement (e.g. specific test procedures, equipment, or sequencing) -- a bare experience claim does not satisfy the requirement's specific ask for a described methodology and technique.

Apex Grid Testing Services has over a decade of experience performing
NETA-standard electrical testing and maintenance for hospital and
industrial clients.

verdicts.description: Offer must include at least five years of prior experience relevant to this solicitation's electrical testing/maintenance work, with a detailed description per year covering contract number, estimated annual dollar value, description of services and the offeror's role, contract start/completion dates, and current customer contact information.
verdicts.rationale: Application states seven years of relevant prior experience, exceeding the 5-year minimum, but -- like the original application's version of this same gap -- never provides the required detailed per-year breakdown (contract number, annual dollar value, description, dates, customer contact) for any year; a bare year-count claim does not satisfy a requirement that specifically demands per-year detail.

evidence.quote:
Apex Grid Testing Services has performed electrical power distribution
testing and maintenance services for healthcare and industrial clients
for the past seven years.

verdicts.description: Offer must include electrical safety training certifications (OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Subpart S and NFPA 70E) submitted with the proposal, or, if unavailable, a written employer certification of having met this requirement submitted with the proposal.
